name: rename-regex
description: Renames every function whose name matches a regular expression, substituting \1..\9 (or $1..$9) from its groups

args.name: pattern
args.description: Regular expression (. [] [^] \d \w \s * + ? {m,n} | () ^ $), searched in each function name

args.name: replace
args.description: Replacement for each match; \0 or $0 is the whole match, \1..\9 or $1..$9 a group

args.name: limit
args.description: Rename at most this many functions (default: all)
